The underlying logic of the DIF (Difference)
is that the short-term Exponential Moving
Average (EMA) reflects the current price
trend, while the long-term EMA reflects
earlier price trends. Therefore, if there is a
significant gap between these two EMAs, it
indicates that the market is trending either
upwards or downwards. The MACD Histogram
\. oscillating near the zero line indicates the

strength of the trend
